scope: Static electrical region assignment at measured contact endpoints; does not establish spike propagation or its cause.

records.region_basis: Soma, axon, and AIS source samples extend halfway along adjoining edges. All remaining cable receives basal-dendrite parameters, including unclassified and astrocyte-labelled samples; this electrical assignment is inferred. No apical identity or myelin insulation is inferred. Source labels remain intact.
